metadata.thinking: OpenClaw default; effective wire field captured per call
metadata.heartbeat: native default cadence; short event-driven scenario

heartbeat.prompt: Internal organizational supervision. Keep a dedicated release-watch task session and its native 60s schedule healthy. Review native session/job status and shared durable notes; repair missing or failed organization when necessary. The task worker owns dependency inspection, operational actions and receipt/current-state maintenance. Do not GET /world or POST /actions on a supervisor tick. Do not duplicate the worker, run its task yourself, or start polling loops. Preserve owner revisions and cancellations across conversations. Curate general memory, skills and session organization only when useful; keep hot memory as pointers to authoritative task notes. Do not rewrite operational statuses from stale summaries. Finish quietly when organization is healthy.

action_boundary.limitation: Caller-declared checks do not enforce hidden owner policy. Invalid attempts stay visible.

observed_preconditions.limitation: Read attribution assumes the declared single operational worker.

receipt_retention.limitation: Numeric references only; content truth and append-only history require a separate mutation audit.

tool_attribution_v2.limitation: Checks root required keys and persisted dispatch results; conditional/value constraints, side-effect truth and all advertised tools require further proof. Historical runs without wire evidence stay unresolved.

topology_execution_v2.limitation: Direct native curl URL arguments, not attribution of every HTTP side effect; complex commands/scripts require separate investigation.

native_runs.error: daemon restarted before cron SpawnTool completed; outcome may be partial

confirmation_worker_timing.overrun_policy: in-flight coalescing, then advance to first future interval slot; no catch-up burst

limits: No statistical replication or multi-day claim.
Smoke verifies selected native surfaces, not every tool or concurrency schedule.
Root required fields are a partial schema check.
Native account totals remain lower for interrupted streams whose endings only the relay consumed.
Common service does not know hidden owner deadlines, cancellations or recipients.
Original failed results are unchanged; v2 diagnostics are supplemental replay.
next_gate: Stabilize worker turn duration and explicit scheduler overrun semantics before more paired samples or supervisor ablations.
